question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Prudent
solution:
The correct answer is **"Imprudent."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Prudent'** means being careful and sensible in making decisions. (मूल्‍यांकन और निर्णय करने में सावधान और विवेकपूर्ण; अनावश्‍यक ख़तरों से बचते हुए)

 
 
• **Example: ***It would be **prudent**__ to get some more advice before you invest your money.*
 
 
 
• **'Imprudent'** means lacking in caution and good judgement. (सावधानी और अच्छे निर्णय की कमी)
 __
 
• **Example:** *It would be **imprudent**__ to leave her winter coat behind.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, **'imprudent' **is the opposite of** 'prudent'.**
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **'Caution'** is a related word to 'prudent' but not an antonym. It means being careful and aware of potential dangers.
 
• **'Unprudent'** is not a valid word in English. The correct antonym is 'imprudent'.
 
• **'Intuition'** is not related to the meaning of 'prudent' and is therefore not an antonym.
